lines.text: Per Weapon mode. Every weapon gets its own anti-recoil.
Other modes switch between two profiles. Per Weapon gives every weapon its own slot.
Hold L2, release Options. Go to Combat, Weapon Detect, and set Type to Per Weapon.
Fire once. The weapon claims its own slot, automatically.
Too high or too low? Hold L2 and press Up or Down, while firing. It's permanent, for that exact weapon.
The full guide is on Rocket Mod dot org.
